name: Clear Podman lock
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
for pid in 861654 861680 875640 875641 875670; do kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
sleep 2
podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
REMOTE
description: Terminate only the orphaned remote Podman commands left by timed-out diagnostics and restore runtime control.
